english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person who is smart or clever.
This is the all-purpose everyday adjective for a person who is intellectually capable or clever.
Choose this for intellectual ability, especially learning and understanding quickly, rather than practical skill.

examples.english: She is very intellectual and learns everything quickly。
My little sister is very clever at learning new things.
